Taylor (People Ops): Quick announcement: we're launching a new Compassionate Loss Support policy today for employees experiencing the death of an immediate family member. Summary below 14 please share.

Taylor (People Ops): Key points: up to 15 calendar days of bereavement leave for immediate family (spouse/child/parent); up to $1,200 bereavement travel/top-up stipend for urgent travel; access to 6 counseling sessions via EAP with expedited booking. Effective immediately.

Rami (Benefits): Stipend rules: covers flights, last-mile travel, and emergency lodging. Submit receipts within 45 days. Fast-track requests (same-day) accepted with boarding pass + brief note. Payroll will apply paid leave automatically for the first 10 days; remaining 5 can be taken as PTO or unpaid.

Leah (People Ops): For remote/hybrid coverage: managers should use the "Bereavement Coverage" template on the HR page so teams know who to contact. We also added an option to pause ongoing performance cycles for up to one review period on request.

Marco (Eng): Is this available to international employees? How about cases involving extended family in different countries?

Taylor (People Ops): Yes, available globally. Stipend is USD-denominated and subject to local tax. For loss of extended relatives, managers can request discretionary leave via People Ops; these are judged case-by-case.

People Ops Bot: Policy page + FAQ: <https://redwood-internal/hr/leave/compassionate-loss-support>. "Compassionate Support" drop-in office hours Fri 3PM PT.

Rami (Benefits): Confidentiality note: employees can provide redacted documentation; we will never require medical records. For payroll/tax questions, DM benefits@redwood.com.

Leah (People Ops): Process quick steps: 1) Take time you need. 2) Submit Bereavement request in HR portal (choose stipend if applicable). 3) Attach receipts within 45 days. 4) If urgent travel cash needed, mark "fast-track" and we'll try to front funds.

Taylor (People Ops): Thanks all. We'll refine wording from feedback. If you have edge cases, ping @Leah or people-ops@redwood.com. :bouquet:
